`atlas-checkout/research/2026-06-03-plan-a-weekend-in-dubai-united-arab-emirates-dubai-anchored-on-a-michelin-starred-dinner-the-restaurant-is-picked/michelin-2-and-3-star-restaurants-in-dubai/index.html`

The artifact covers all 5 Dubai restaurants with 2+ Michelin stars from the 2025 guide (announced May 22, 2025):

**★★★ Three stars:** [FZN by Björn Frantzén](https://www.restaurantfzn.com/) (Nordic–Asian, AED 2,000+, Atlantis The Palm) and [Trèsind Studio](https://tresindstudio.com/) (world's first 3★ Indian restaurant, AED 1,350, St. Regis Palm).

**★★ Two stars:** [Il Ristorante – Niko Romito](https://www.bulgarihotels.com/en_US/dubai/dining/il-ristorante-niko-romito) (Italian at Bulgari, AED 1,150), [Row on 45](https://www.rowon45dubai.com/) (French–Japanese, 45th floor views, AED 1,345), and [STAY by Yannick Alléno](https://www.oneandonlyresorts.com/the-palm/dining/stay-by-yannick-alleno) (French at One&Only, from AED 900).
